title: RV park website care
text: Weekend website care for RV parks along one Texas highway corridor: a monthly fee to keep their site, booking link and Google listing working, with one visit a quarter.

title: Clinic-issued ID tags
text: Tap-to-read ID tags for kids in ABA therapy, sold to clinics and handed to parents at intake, with emergency contacts and communication notes a first responder can read.

title: Night-shift nurse meals
text: Healthy meal prep delivered to night-shift nurses at two Houston hospitals, ready in the break room at 2am, paid weekly by subscription.

title: Voice memo estimates
text: An app that turns a contractor's voice memo from the job site into a written, itemized estimate and texts it to the client before the contractor leaves the driveway.

title: Charter booking with weather refunds
text: Booking for small Gulf coast fishing charter captains with live weather checks that cancel and refund automatically when the marine forecast turns bad.
